remarks:
Just a short drive from the Village of Ellicottville, this is the ideal location to build your smart investment in one of New York’s premier four-season resort towns. Set in Ellicottville’s newest upscale subdivision, these spacious 2–5 acre lots offer a peaceful, wooded landscape with beautiful views, abundant wildlife, and a sense of serenity that’s hard to find—yet only 45–50 minutes from the Southtowns of Buffalo.

This thoughtfully planned community is surrounded by recreational trails perfect for hiking, snowshoeing, and cross-country skiing. With easy access from Route 219—just turn right onto Lindberg Road and left onto Poverty Hill Road—you’ll find yourself at the top of the ridge, enjoying views and quiet like nowhere else. Located close to both Holiday Valley and HoliMont ski resorts, this development is perfect for seasonal getaways or year-round living.

Each lot offers a unique opportunity to match your build to your Ellicottville lifestyle. Whether you're planning a cozy chalet, full-time home, or rental property, there are no restrictions on rentals here. Underground electric . The HOA ensures your investment is protected, covering road plowing and trail maintenance for an annual fee of $1,625. Best of all—the owner is willing to hold the mortgage, making ownership even more attainable.
